summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 1, a supplement of financial highlights for the six months ended September 30, 2026, incorporated by reference into two existing Form F-3 shelf registration statements. Results: net revenue 1,294.2 billion yen (+24.6% year over year), non-interest expenses 934.7 billion yen (+26.0%), pre-tax income 359.5 billion yen, net income attributable to NHI shareholders 249.3 billion yen, diluted EPS 82.97 yen, ROE 13.3%. Total assets 67.5 trillion yen; Common Equity Tier 1 ratio 12.6%, consolidated capital adequacy 15.4%. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated; this is routine interim financial disclosure, not a special situation. Watch only for revisions in the semi-annual securities report.
